checks.dasharo_feature: SPI controller and chipset write protections
checks.limitation: Linux-only collection does not test an external hardware write-protect pin or attempt a flash write.
checks.purpose: Collect evidence about whether privileged software can rewrite critical firmware regions.
checks.title: Firmware write resistance

checks.limitation: A hardware WP pin and external-programmer resistance cannot be proven from a normal Linux scan.
checks.purpose: Preserve any Linux-visible evidence of protected flash regions and firmware update policy.
checks.title: Hardware flash protection

checks.dasharo_feature: Intel Boot Guard or equivalent verified boot
checks.limitation: The collector records fwupd/kernel-visible state; it does not independently inspect fused keys.
checks.purpose: Collect CPU-vendor and fwupd evidence for Intel Boot Guard or AMD Platform Secure Boot.
checks.title: Hardware-verified firmware boot

checks.limitation: PCR values require event-log replay or external attestation before they become integrity conclusions.
checks.purpose: Collect TPM capabilities, PCR banks, and the binary and parsed measured-boot event log.
checks.title: TPM measured boot

checks.limitation: Collection does not execute an unsigned boot component to test rejection.
checks.purpose: Collect Secure Boot state, UEFI trust databases, boot entries, EFI variables, and kernel lockdown.
checks.title: UEFI Secure Boot

checks.limitation: No CHIPSEC driver is loaded; low-level SMRAM and SMM code checks are outside this simple profile.
checks.purpose: Collect fwupd HSI attributes related to SMM BIOS write protection and platform isolation.
checks.title: SMM firmware isolation

checks.limitation: Linux IOMMU activation alone does not prove protection was active before the OS started.
checks.purpose: Collect fwupd pre-boot DMA attributes, ACPI tables, Linux IOMMU groups, and relevant kernel messages.
checks.title: Early DMA protection

checks.limitation: The scan does not install a deliberately invalid capsule to prove rejection.
checks.purpose: Collect update-capable devices, release metadata, ESRT entries, and configured remotes.
checks.title: Authenticated firmware updates

checks.limitation: No downgrade is attempted; absence of metadata is not proof that downgrade protection is absent.
checks.purpose: Preserve fwupd HSI, device flags, lowest-version metadata, and firmware-exposed BIOS settings.
checks.title: Firmware rollback protection

checks.dasharo_feature: Controlled boot menu, USB boot, and network boot
checks.limitation: Vendors expose different settings; a missing setting is recorded as unavailable rather than disabled.
checks.purpose: Collect boot order, boot entries, and firmware settings exposed through fwupd or Linux sysfs.
checks.title: Controlled boot policy

checks.dasharo_feature: Signed recovery image or dual-bank recovery
checks.limitation: A normal running-OS scan cannot prove that recovery survives corruption or power loss.
checks.purpose: Collect recovery-related device flags, ESRT metadata, and firmware settings.
checks.title: Firmware recovery capability

checks.limitation: No metadata refresh is performed, so cached release information may be stale.
checks.purpose: Record fwupd versions, configured metadata remotes, hardware IDs, and cached releases.
checks.title: Release metadata and provenance

checks.limitation: The collector does not clear, provision, or take ownership of the TPM.
checks.purpose: Collect TPM device nodes, fixed properties, algorithms, and PCR availability.
checks.title: TPM presence and state

checks.dasharo_feature: Firmware security beyond the main BIOS
checks.limitation: Devices absent from fwupd may still contain firmware; absence from the list is not proof of absence.
checks.purpose: Inventory firmware-visible devices and correlate them with PCI and USB topology.
checks.title: Peripheral firmware coverage
